_comment: Fleet composer dependency hygiene (fleet-app-specification §2): composer-require-checker finds SYMBOLS USED BUT NOT REQUIRED (the composer-side twin of knip's unlisted-dependency check). Run via `composer require-check`. First run per app is measure-and-tune: add genuinely-runtime-provided symbols (PHP extension classes like Redis, PECL classes) to symbol-whitelist with a one-line reason — never whitelist a symbol a real composer package should provide; require the package instead.
